description: Mechanized pavement pothole sealing work is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Since December 2016, the City of Montreal has been filling potholes using all-in-one mechanized equipment including the functionality of georeferencing the position of plugged potholes. These datasets contain information on where and when potholes were sealed by the Road Network Infrastructure Service (SIRR) using mechanized equipment. Coverage: Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Its tags are Artery, Causeway, Clogging, GPS, Pothole. It offers 12 resource(s) in CSV, GPKG, HTML, XLS. The portal shows 2026-05-27 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 4.0 Attribution (CC-BY) licence – Quebec. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
